text: CIA agents in 1970s Poland wrote a line of a book into a box by rows, copied it out by columns, and used that as the key on a letter table: a remembered rule, a matrix, then the table, close to Sanborn's own words.

K1-K3 and Carter's book as the key text, every box width from 2 to 50, columns in several orders, Bury's reciprocal table and three others on the standard or KRYPTOS order, every starting letter; all 24 known letters must agree.
No setting fits K4 or any of ten scrambled copies; the best partial agreement on K4 is what the copies reach too. Planted texts are found. F11.3 closed for these key texts.
